_versionConstant: Deliberately absent. This repo has no displayed APP_VERSION — AboutPage and ChangelogPage both render CHANGELOG[0].version from src/components/shell/changelogData.ts, so the changelog entry IS the version bump. That surface is tied to CHANGELOG.md by changelog-surfaces.test.ts, and CHANGELOG.md is tied to package.json below, so the displayed version is covered transitively.

extraVersionSurfaces.note: Not displayed anywhere. It is stamped into every exported model as `appVersion` by exportModel.ts and exportAllModels.ts, so it is the provenance stamp on user data. It sat at 0.12.1 while the app shipped 0.18.15 — six minor versions of exports carried a wrong stamp before v0.18.16 caught it.
